job_description:
Data Analyst

We are hiring a data analyst to own reporting and experimentation. You will build dashboards, run analysis, and deliver insights to product teams.

Requirements:
- Strong SQL and data analysis skills
- Experience building dashboards and business intelligence reporting
- Familiarity with experimentation and A/B testing
- Python for automation is a plus
notes: Strong data-analytics match, mid-level; SQL/dashboards/experimentation resume aligned to an analyst JD. Resume band 76-90 is the solid-mid tier: one role, four sections, three quantified bullets. Match band 84-100 - the resume names all but one of the JD's terms ('Testing', which it phrases as A/B experiments).
